documents.title: What Workflows are and the standard workflow
documents.content: Workflows at /workflows are named, ordered sets of destinations that represent a way of working, such as Bookkeeping or Quotes. Choose Set as standard on a workflow to save it as your default. A standard workflow stays selected across logins, drives the Welcome page's Start your day button, and the sidebar's Workspace group follows it. Only one workflow is standard at a time and it is marked Standard. Choose Clear standard, or Restore default Workspace, to return to the default Workspace destinations. Nothing is applied automatically.

documents.title: Create, edit, reorder and sort a workflow
documents.content: Choose New Workflow, enter a name such as Bookkeeping, and create it. A name is required. Choose Edit on a workflow to open its editor. Add steps by dragging destinations from the Destinations palette or clicking them; search the palette to find one. Reorder steps by dragging or with a step's move up and move down menu, and remove a step by dragging it back to the palette or using its menu. Sort offers Name A to Z or Name Z to A. Choose Save to store the workflow; Back asks before discarding unsaved changes. Open shows the steps as numbered tiles.

documents.title: Start from a template workflow
documents.content: Template Workflows offers nine role-based starting points: Accountant, Lawyer, Consultant, Virtual Assistant, Paralegal, Field Contractor, Marketing Agency, Property Manager, and IT & MSP. Choosing one copies it into your own list; it is never applied automatically. After copying it is an ordinary workflow you can rename, edit, or delete. If a workflow with the same name is already in your list, Ogeemo tells you it is already there instead of adding a duplicate.
